'''Brays''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] Security.<ref name="backlash" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sothais Saar]] was in a meeting with [[Wynn Dorvan]], personal assistant to [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], when Saar suddenly experienced the same [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] other Jedi Knights were suffering from. Saar escaped from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], where the meeting was held, despite Dorvan ordering a lockdown of the building and alerting Captain Brays of the situation.<ref name="backlash" />
